item.title: Delhi Dangal Warriors Beat Tiigers of Mumbai Dangals 6–3, Keep PWL 2026 Semifinal Hopes Alive
item.description: Delhi Dangal Warriors defeated Tiigers of Mumbai Dangals 6–3 in Match 13 of PWL 2026 at Noida Indoor Stadium. Wins from Anastasiya Alpyeeva, Sujeet Kalkal and others kept Delhi’s semifinal hopes alive as Mumbai ended their campaign winless.

item.title: Harry Brook’s 57-Ball Century Powers England to Historic ODI Series Win in Sri Lanka
item.description: Harry Brook smashed a blistering 57-ball hundred as England beat Sri Lanka by 53 runs in Colombo, clinching the ODI series and ending the hosts’ five-year unbeaten home run.

item.title: Rybakina Decimates Swiatek In Aus Open Quarterfinals
item.description: Rod Laver Arena: Elena Rybakina ended world No.2 Iga Swiatek’s hopes in the Australian Open quarterfinals on Wednesday with a dominant 7-5 6-1 victory at Rod Laver Arena.

item.title: Markram’s Powers South Africa to 9-Wicket T20I Win Over West Indies
item.description: Aiden Markram smashed a career-best 86 not out as South Africa cruised to a nine-wicket win over West Indies in the first T20I at Boland Park.

item.title: Abraham Completes Aston Villa Return From Besiktas
item.description: West Bromwich Albion: England striker Tammy Abraham has completed a move back to Aston Villa from Besiktas, signing a four-and-a-half-year contract with the Premier League title contenders.

item.title: From Zimbabwe to Bangladesh: How ‘Lucky Scotland’ Keeps Entering T20 World Cups
item.description: Scotland replaces Bangladesh in the ICC 2026 T20 World Cup, continuing a unique pattern where the “lucky team” steps in whenever a scheduled team withdraws, as seen previously in 2009.

item.title: Hoffenheim Maintains Perfect 2026 Start Despite Red Card In Bremen
item.description: UEFA Champions League: Werder Bremen's slump deepened as Hoffenheim preserved their unbeaten start to the new year with a composed 2-0 away victory, even after being reduced to 10 men in a rescheduled Bundesliga matchday 16 fixture at the Weserstadion.

item.title: Anupam Kher Calls 'cool Dude' Rohit Sharma Absolutely 'real'
item.description: Anupam Kher: Veteran actor Anupam Kher enjoyed an accidental meet-cute with the former Indian cricket captain, and 'Cool Dude' Rohit Sharma.

item.title: Pegula Powers Past Anisimova To Reach Maiden Aus Open Semifinal
item.description: American Amanda Anisimova: Jessica Pegula finally broke her Melbourne ceiling on Wednesday, defeating fellow American Amanda Anisimova 6-2, 7-6(1) at Rod Laver Arena to secure a first-ever Australian Open semifinal berth.

item.title: WPL: DC Skipper Jemimah Rodrigues Penalised For Slow Over-rate Vs GG
item.description: Baroda Cricket Association Stadium: Delhi Capitals captain Jemimah Rodrigues has been fined Rs 12 lakh for maintaining a slow over-rate following her team’s narrow three-run defeat to Gujarat Giants in the Women’s Premier League (WPL) match at the Baroda Cricket Association Stadium (Kotambi) on Tuesday.
